summary: Join our ICT managers training course to develop key skills and principles. Elevate your management capabilities and lead your team to success in technology.
lede: Essential Principles and Skills for ICT Managers builds the capabilities needed to align technology initiatives with business goals and demonstrate meaningful results. It develops practical skills in strategic planning, resource allocation, stakeholder management, risk assessment, team leadership, and performance evaluation. The course helps turn technical expertise into coordinated management practice, even when budgets, complexity, and competing priorities create challenges. You will explore frameworks and strategies for optimizing ICT operations, managing change, and leading initiatives that are both technically sound and strategically impactful.
modules: Strategic Role of ICT in Business
prerequisites: Participants should have a foundational understanding of ICT operations and management principles.
